title: Finite cone certificate
scope: Algebra over a field, given two affine intersection equations.

title: Conditional Pythagorean deduction
scope: Requires both sine relations and nonzero product.

title: Exact truncation defect
scope: Algebraic truncation; full geometric realization of original sequence remains open.

title: Area-based bridge
scope: Abstract AreaPlane; base-height area principle is assumed.

title: Area-free bridge
scope: Abstract LengthPlane; local AA rule is assumed.

title: Normalized projection criterion
scope: BasicLength; positive-slope test equivalent to quadratic length law.

title: Exact projection defect
scope: BasicLength. Positive slope; no AA assumption.

title: Global stability
scope: BasicLength. Nonnegative tolerance; uniform hypothesis at every positive slope.

title: Finite-sample global stability
scope: BasicLength plus triangle inequality, nonnegative tolerance and mesh, finite covering of [0,1], bounded absolute squared-length error at all sample slopes.

title: Right-angle shrinking chain
scope: Positive ordered legs; affine quarter-turn perpendicularity.

title: Infinite boundary length sums
scope: BasicLength, positive ordered legs; no area or AA assumption.

title: Convergence to the finite apex
scope: Positive ordered legs; convergence in the ordinary real coordinate topology.

title: Infinite sums equal actual boundary lengths
scope: BasicLength; positive ordered legs; no AA or area premise.

title: Improved global finite-sample stability
scope: BasicLength plus triangle inequality; nonnegative tolerance and mesh; finite covering of [0,1]; absolute squared-length sample error. Bound ε+2δ.

title: Optimal absolute-error slope Lipschitz constant
scope: Sharpness for the universal absolute-error Lipschitz bound on [0,1], not a claim of optimal global mesh error.

title: Recovery from dense rational slopes
scope: BasicLength plus triangle inequality; exact squared-length agreement on every positive rational slope at most one.

title: Two-Lipschitz absolute squared-length error
scope: BasicLength plus triangle inequality; slopes in [0,1].
